Your holdings: SOXL (-41.2%) and SPAL (-28.71%) are flagged for attention. They're leveraged ETFs that decay, and they're deep in the red.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia options activity ahead of its catalysts. Also, watch how quantum stocks perform after their recent rally.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and watching for clear signals in your core tech names.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out given the deep loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Consider trimming or stopping out given the deep loss and decay risk.
